title: IVG Intense Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Pineapple Ice delivers the tropical sweetness of ripe Pineapple paired with a crisp Ice layer. The result is a flavour that balances juicy fruit notes with a refreshing chill. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt provides clear flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Pineapple Ice is best used with mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, vape pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Pineapple Ice suits tropical fruit fans who like a cool finish.
